title: 恐龙的皮是什么样的
subtitle: 鳞片、羽毛，还有颜色
character: wearing a chestnut brown t-shirt, moss green shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, thick opaque gouache with bold brush marks, chestnut brown, moss green and warm cream

pages.zh:
墙上挂着一块皮，
上面全是小格子，
摸起来像我的篮球。
爸爸说，
那是恐龙的皮印。
pages.scene: The little boy reaches up to touch a large fossil skin impression mounted on a museum wall, feeling its pebbled surface.

pages.zh:
大恐龙身上
是一块一块的鳞。
不是鱼身上那种会翘的，
是平平地铺着，
像地砖一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one patch of skin shown greatly magnified on a cream background, covered with many small flat scales fitted edge to edge with no gaps. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
皮本来是软的，
烂得最快。
可要是刚好
被很细的泥盖住，
就能印下一个印子。
pages.scene: A flat bed of fine wet grey mud filling the whole picture, with one rectangular patch of pebbled scale texture pressed into its surface, the mud smooth and empty all around that patch.

pages.zh:
有的恐龙有羽毛。
先是细细的一根根，
像绒毛；
后来才慢慢长成
一片一片的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three feather shapes in a row on a cream background, the first a single thin filament, the second a tuft of several filaments, the third a full flat feather with a central shaft. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最早的羽毛
不是用来飞的。
是用来保暖，
也用来让自己
看起来更好看。
pages.scene: One small fluffy feathered dinosaur puffing out its plumage on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
颜色怎么知道呢？
羽毛里有很小的颗粒，
形状不一样，
颜色就不一样。
显微镜下看得见。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two magnified grain shapes on a cream background, one round and one long and rod-like, each with a colour swatch beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有一种小恐龙，
身上是栗红色的，
尾巴上还有
一圈一圈的白环，
像浣熊的尾巴。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur standing on a cream background, every feather on its body a deep chestnut red brown, its long tail banded from base to tip with evenly spaced cream white rings.

pages.zh:
还有的恐龙
背上颜色深，
肚子颜色浅。
这样在太阳底下
看起来平平的，不容易被发现。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dinosaur seen from the side on a cream background with its back shaded dark and its belly shaded pale, and one sun above it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
个子越大的
越用不着毛。
身体大，热气散得慢，
毛要是太多，
反而会热坏。
pages.scene: One enormous bare-skinned dinosaur standing in strong sunlight on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的恐龙
皮里还长着骨头，
一块一块嵌在背上，
像穿了一件
脱不下来的盔甲。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one piece of skin cut through on a cream background showing several solid bony plates embedded inside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
甲龙的尾巴尖上
有一个骨头做的锤子。
甩起来呼呼响，
能把追它的那只
打得转身就走。
pages.scene: One armoured dinosaur swinging its heavy bony tail club, motion lines behind it, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把手
按在那块皮印上。
一格一格的，
硌手。
原来恐龙摸上去是这样。
pages.scene: The little boy presses his palm flat against the fossil skin impression on the museum wall, feeling the texture, absorbed.
